name: 29631 · Clemson, SC
findings: ZIP 29631 (Clemson) has 78 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29631 (Clemson) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 29631 (Clemson) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.
